test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Abby's __humility__ towards the poor and needy people of his locality is really admirable.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arrogance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"humility"** means having a modest or low view of one’s importance; being humble and free from pride. (विनम्रता)

 
 
• **Example:** Her humility in accepting the award was appreciated by everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Arrogance"** refers to having an exaggerated sense of one’s own importance or abilities; being overly proud or conceited. (अहंकार)
 
 
• **Example:** His arrogance made it difficult for him to accept constructive criticism.
 
 
 
• Since "arrogance" is the opposite of "humility," it is the most appropriate antonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arrogance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Amiability** (मिलनसारिता): Being friendly and pleasant in manner.

 
 
• **Example:** His amiability made him popular among his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Sincerity** (ईमानदारी): The quality of being honest and genuine in thoughts and actions.
 
 
• **Example:** Her sincerity in her work earned her the respect of her peers.
 
 
 
• **Modesty** (विनम्रता): The quality of being unassuming or moderate in one’s achievements or abilities.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his great success, he always maintained his modesty.
 
 

35:T939,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
